messages:
ops-pager: INCIDENT 1758214073 — P2 GPU OOM spike on decode-cluster-usw2 (3/12 nodes reporting OOM). Error pattern: cuda out of memory during streaming/decode path, correlated with long-running token streams. Pager routed to @oncall and eng-runtime.

oncall-bot: @Emma Zhang you are oncall for runtime. Escalation: please triage.

Emma Zhang: looking. seeing burst of streaming decode requests with unbounded token lengths. some clients sending max_tokens: 0 or omitting header. suspect SDK change.

Raj Patel: grabbing logs now. example decode pod: decode-4f2c. tail shows repeated: \"cudaErrorOutOfMemory\" followed by container restart.

Raj Patel: quick grep: 
```
kubectl -n runtime logs decode-4f2c decoder | grep -i oom | tail -n 50
# shows OOM on decode loop, request ids: r-33a2b r-79c1d r-11f00
```

Emma Zhang: can we throttle the streaming route? set route concurrency=4 and cap max_tokens at router to 1024 as emergency guard.

Ben Liu: I can push a router policy change. doing a canary update to 2 routers first. will add header override to enforce default_max_tokens=512 if client omits value.

Maria Gomez: CS note — customers may see 500s and dropped streams. I'm pulling impacted request ids for incident report. initial metric: 1.6% error rate uplift on streaming endpoints last 12m.

Raj Patel: traced a pattern: SDK v1.2.3 started sending \"max_tokens: 0\" when unset (bug). decoder treats 0 as unlimited and doesn't apply server cap. hits KV cache growth + long attention -> OOM.

Emma Zhang: ok plan: (1) enforce server-side token cap 1024 now, (2) rollback gateway side to v1.2.2 for a subset of customers (if possible), (3) rollout hotfix to decoder to treat 0 as default not unlimited.

Ben Liu: applying policy now. command: 
```
redwoodctl router update --route streaming --set default_max_tokens=512 --canary 2
```

Ben Liu: canary applied to 2 pods. watching.

oncall-bot: Canary pass window started (5m). Alerts suppressed for canary.

Emma Zhang: also enabling token-guard circuit: abort if token_count > 8192 to avoid tail disasters. patching runtime config.

Raj Patel: spinning rolling restart on decode pods in small batches to free fragmented GPU memory. will restart 2 at a time.

Maria Gomez: customer impact update: Found 12 customer sessions with dropped streams. flagged high-touch account AcmeAI (ticket #CS-2387). Noah prepping communication.

Noah (CS): I'll send a targeted update to AcmeAI with mitigation and ETA. ETA for full mitigation ~30-45m.

Ben Liu: canary looks good, error rate on canary route down to baseline. rolling policy to remaining routers.

Emma Zhang: rolling router policy complete. token-guard enabled cluster-wide. observing OOM count dropping.

Raj Patel: decoder hotfix ready (treat max_tokens<=0 as missing -> apply default). deploying to two canary decode pods now.

Ben Liu: decoder canary healthy. memory profiles stabilized.

Emma Zhang: request drops reduced to normal. OOMs in last 10m: 0. Confirming with telemetry.

Maria Gomez: CS update drafted, will send to affected customers with notes: root cause suspected SDK bug (v1.2.3), mitigations applied (server caps, runtime fix), and follow-ups.

Noah (CS): sent initial note to AcmeAI and queued broader communication.

Raj Patel: follow-ups: file SDK bug, add unit test to gateway for max_tokens handling, add telemetry alert for unusually high avg token length per request.

Emma Zhang: creating follow-up tickets: RUNTIME-1429 (decoder treat 0 as missing), GATE-8421 (router default cap), SDK-366 (patch v1.2.3). Also schedule postmortem and retro.

Ben Liu: recommend across-the-board guard: server should never accept 0 as unlimited. push policy to prod as permanent safeguard.

Emma Zhang: agreed. I'll keep monitoring for +60m and loop back to oncall rotation. Great teamwork, thanks. :thumbsup: 

oncall-bot: Incident 1758214073 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager will auto-close if no regressions in 60m.
